projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: The incubator takes a team from a problem to a pitch in 14 steps: guided forms, an AI mentor and a review of every step.
projects.emptyText: Start with a problem you want to solve — the AI mentor will help you get to the pitch.
projects.emptyAll: The university has no projects yet

create.title: New project
create.description: You can change the title and industry later. After creating the project, the first step opens — "The problem and who has it".
create.name: Title
create.nameHint: A working title — short and clear.
create.taglinePlaceholder: One sentence on what the project does
create.accept: I have read the policy and agree to it
create.acceptRequired: Accept the intellectual property policy to create a project

workspace.archived: The project is archived — answers are read-only.
workspace.readOnly: You see the project as a supervisor: the team fills in the answers, you can comment and approve steps.
workspace.notFoundText: It may have been removed, or you have no access to it.

save.offline: Offline — will save when back online
save.updatedByOthers: Other members have just changed this step. Your edits will be merged with their version when saved.

step.left: To complete the step, still needed: {{fields}}

gap.required: Fill in this field to complete the step
gap.minLength_one: The step needs at least {{count}} character here
gap.minLength_other: The step needs at least {{count}} characters here
gap.minItems_one: Add at least {{count}} item to complete the step
gap.minItems_other: Add at least {{count}} items to complete the step

check.note: An AI recommendation, not a grade: the team and the supervisor decide. {{model}} · {{prompt}} · {{time}}

approve.title: Approve the step
approve.description: Approval counts the step as done even when the minimum is not met. The team will see your comment. If the team changes the answers, the approval is withdrawn.
approve.stale: The team changed the step while you were reviewing it. We loaded the new answers: check them and approve again.

conflict.title: The step was changed at the same time
conflict.description: Another member saved these fields while you were editing them. Choose which version to keep.
conflict.descriptionBy: {{name}} saved these fields while you were editing them. Choose which version to keep.
conflict.difference: Your changes compared with the server version

history.title: History of changes
history.emptyText: Every save of the field appears here, and any earlier value can be restored.

comments.title: Comments
comments.emptyText: Ask the team or the supervisor about this field; mention someone with @.
comments.deleteText: Replies to it are deleted too.

mentor.title: AI mentor
mentor.name: Mentor
mentor.welcome: Hi! I will help with the step "{{step}}": ask questions, suggest a method and show how to make the wording stronger. The decisions and texts are yours.

prompts.start: Where do I start this step?
prompts.check: What is missing in my answers?

mentor.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
mentor.readOnly: The project team asks the mentor; you can read their conversation.

overview.allDone: All 14 steps done — the project is ready for evaluation and the showcase.

idea_stage.title: Idea and problem
idea_stage.hint: First stage done: problem, audience, customer journey and solution

market_stage.title: Market and team
market_stage.hint: Second stage done: market, competitors, business model and team

product_stage.title: Product and metrics
product_stage.hint: Third stage done: MVP, metrics, unit economics and risks

launch_stage.title: Ready to launch
launch_stage.hint: All stages done: roadmap and pitch

first_review.title: First AI review
first_review.hint: The team checked a step with the AI mentor

materials_ready.title: Materials ready
materials_ready.hint: A one-pager, pitch deck or startup passport was built

team_of_three.title: Team of three
team_of_three.hint: The project has at least three members

activity.emptyText: Edits of steps, comments and completed steps of the team appear here.

unit.title: Unit economics
unit.hint: Fill in the price, variable cost, CAC and purchases — the calculation appears here.
unit.good: LTV/CAC above 3: acquiring a customer pays off with room to spare.
unit.low: LTV/CAC below 3: think about raising the price or repeat purchases, or lowering the acquisition cost.

canvas.title: Your Lean Canvas
canvas.text: Blocks from earlier steps are read-only; edit them through the link. Blue blocks are filled in on this step.

materials.title: Materials
materials.text: Build the materials from the project's answers — the AI adds no facts that are not in the steps.
materials.emptyText: Generate a one-pager, a pitch deck or a startup passport — they appear here.
materials.scheduled: The material is being prepared — this takes up to a minute

about.one_pager: The project on one page for partners and the jury
about.pitch_deck: 10–12 slides: problem, solution, market, team, the ask
about.passport: A project card with a QR code to the project page

settings.title: Team and settings
settings.hideSensitiveHint: Unit economics and technology stay hidden from everyone outside the team, also on the showcase.
settings.titlePlaceholder: Role in the team, e.g. CTO
settings.transferText: The new owner can manage the team and archive the project. You stay a member.
settings.removeText: They lose access to the project; their earlier edits stay in the history.
settings.leaveText: You lose access to the project. The owner can add you back.
settings.archiveText: The project becomes read-only. You cannot undo this yourself.

dashboard.startText: Describe a problem you want to solve. In 14 steps with the AI mentor you will get to the market, business model and pitch.
